title: NHL Logo Quiz Part 4: Hard Mode
headline: NHL Logo Quiz Part 4: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NHL logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NHL team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NHL team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

readMore.label: How Every NHL Team Got Its Name

items.piece: A notch in the navy ring, near the bottom of the bolt.
items.fact: The Lightning unveiled their current bolt in January 2011, dropping black and silver for a simple blue and white look.

items.piece: The gold and blue stripes at the tip of the note's wing.
items.fact: The blue note has been the team's emblem since 1967. The club is named after W.C. Handy's song St. Louis Blues.

items.piece: A teal, orange and black edge of the triangle behind the shark.
items.fact: The Sharks updated their original 1991 logo in 2007. The shark still bites down on a hockey stick.

items.piece: White cutting into black, with the edge of the orange dot.
items.fact: Sam Ciccone designed the winged P in 1967. The orange dot is a puck, and the logo has stayed essentially unchanged since.

items.piece: The gold border and charcoal of the helmet at the top right.
items.fact: The team revealed its knight's helmet logo in November 2016. The opening in the helmet forms a V for Vegas.

items.piece: Gold and white stripes in the black streaks trailing the helmet.
items.fact: For 2020-21 the Senators went back to a flat centurion in profile, close to their 1997 to 2007 logo.

items.piece: The bottom of the navy stick, with the tip of the red puck.
items.fact: The Capitals' wordmark returned in 2007. As in the original 1974 look, the t is a hockey stick with a puck.

items.piece: Light blue and black stripes on the mammoth's head.
items.fact: The Mammoth logo was unveiled on May 7, 2025. The curved tusk forms a U for Utah.
